message.example: Baseer API is healthy and operational

id.description: Unique identifier of destination point of interest

startLocation.description: Human-readable starting point name detected from QR code

estimatedDistanceMeters.description: Estimated distance in meters to target destination

totalSteps.description: عدد الخطوات الإرشادية في المسار (Number of instructional guidance steps in route)

example: وجهتك هي الباب الثاني على يسارك (شؤون الطلبة)
voiceInstructions.description: Sequential voice guidance instructions in Arabic

currentQrCode.description: Current scanned QR code identifier. Allowed QR codes: QR_ENTRANCE_01, QR_HALLWAY_A, QR_ELEVATOR_01, QR_STAIRS_EAST. Fake test triggers: "invalid" -> ERR_INVALID_QR_CODE, "notfound" -> ERR_QR_NOT_FOUND.

destinationId.description: Target destination ID (from GET /destinations). Fake test triggers: "invalid" -> ERR_DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND, "routeerror" -> ERR_ROUTE_CALCULATION_FAILED.

extractedText.example: Panadol Extra 500mg - Take 2 tablets every 8 hours after meals.
extractedText.description: Raw extracted text from the image

arabicSimplifiedText.example: بنادول إكسترا 500 مجم - قرصين كل 8 ساعات بعد الأكل
arabicSimplifiedText.description: Simplified Arabic spoken text tailored for text-to-speech

imageBase64.description: Base64 encoded image string (JPEG/PNG). Testing fake triggers: send "blurry" for ERR_IMAGE_BLURRY, "dark" for ERR_IMAGE_TOO_DARK, "notext" for ERR_NO_TEXT_DETECTED (OCR only), "unsupported" for ERR_UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_FORMAT, or "toolarge" for ERR_FILE_TOO_LARGE.

userInput.example: شوفلي الورقة دي مكتوب فيها إيه

confidence.description: Confidence score of intent classification (0 to 1)

spokenResponse.example: تمام، وجه الكاميرا نحو الورقة وسأقرأها لك حالاً
spokenResponse.description: Spoken confirmation in Egyptian Arabic for text-to-speech

actionToTriggerOnMobile.description: Specific mobile screen or camera mode to automatically trigger

userSpeech.example: شوفلي الورقة دي مكتوب فيها إيه
userSpeech.description: Colloquial Egyptian Arabic transcript. Fake test trigger: send "unrecognized" or unsupported words to test ERR_INTENT_NOT_RECOGNIZED.

description.example: أمامك طاولة خشبية عليها زجاجة ماء ومفتاح، وعلى يمينك مقعد فارغ
description.description: Natural Arabic scene narration for text-to-speech

confidence.description: Overall vision detection confidence score (0 to 1)

condition.description: Physical condition or banknote series note

disclaimer.example: قد تتأثر دقة اللون بإضاءة الغرفة الحالية

spokenMeaning.example: إشارة عبور مشاة، يمكنك العبور بحذر

spokenDescription.example: الشخص الذي أمامك يبتسم ويبدو سعيداً

hazardDetected.description: Whether an active proximity hazard is detected

obstacleType.description: Type or classification of detected obstacle in Arabic

distanceMeters.description: Estimated distance in meters to obstacle

hapticAlertPattern.description: Recommended mobile haptic vibration feedback pattern

spokenWarning.example: انتبه! أمامك درجات سلم على بعد خطوتين
